description_en: Purchases products. This operation supports pay-as-you-go purchases of DataWorks, OSS, PAI, and MaxCompute
description_zh: 购买产品，目前只支持购买DataWorks后付费、OSS后付费、PAI后付费、MaxCompute后付费
name: CreateProductOrders

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay for all products listed in the Products parameter.

true: Enables automatic payment.

false: Disables automatic payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动购买（支付）Products参数中传入的所有产品。
true：自动支付。
false：不自动支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal
fields.help_zh:
是否自动续费。
true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en: The billing method. Currently, only POSTPAY is supported
fields.name: charge_type

fields.help_en: The subscription duration. This parameter is used with PricingCycle. Currently, only a value of 1 is supported
fields.help_zh: 购买时长，与pricingCycle配合使用，目前只支持1
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en: The code of the instance property
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The name of the instance property
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the instance property
fields.name: value
instance_properties

fields.help_en: The order type. Currently, only BUY is supported
fields.name: order_type

fields.help_en:
The billing cycle. The following values are supported:

Month: Monthly billing. Only DataWorks_share supports this value.

Hour: Hourly billing. Only OSS_share and MaxCompute_share support this value
fields.help_zh:
计价单位，目前支持如下值
Month：按月计价，DataWorks_share只支持Month。
Hour：按小时计价，OSS_share、MaxCompute_share只支持Hour
fields.name: pricing_cycle

fields.help_en:
The product code. The following codes are supported:

DataWorks_share: The pay-as-you-go DataWorks product.

MaxCompute_share: The pay-as-you-go MaxCompute product.

PAI_share: The pay-as-you-go PAI product.

OSS_share: The pay-as-you-go OSS product
fields.help_zh:
产品code，目前支持的如下code：

DataWorks_share：Dataworks后付费商品。
MaxCompute_share：MaxCompute后付费商品。
PAI_share：PAI后付费商品。
OSS_share：OSS后付费商品
fields.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The list of products to purchase
parameters.help_zh: 需要购买的产品列表，使用逗号分割
parameters.name: products

BuyProductRequestId.description_en: The ID of the product purchase request

Message.description_en: The message returned for the purchase

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the purchase order
